_comment: Dev-only, advisory mutation harness (True Coverage C3). break:null => never fails a build. inPlace:true => instrument real files + restore (no monorepo sandbox). Uses the built-in COMMAND runner: the experimental @hughescr/stryker-bun-runner's Bun-Inspector WebSocket fails to connect locally (esp. Windows); the command runner just runs a scoped `bun test` and is reliable cross-platform. NOTE: security-invariants.test.ts is intentionally NOT in this scope — it makes source-TEXT assertions (reads the .ts and regex-matches) that break once Stryker instruments the file in place; executor.ts behavior is covered by executor-delegation + executor-flagship (which pinned it to 100%). See docs/contributors/mutation-testing.md.
